title: Paging for CS fallback to A/Gb or Iu mode

entities.name: Paging for CS fallback to A/Gb or Iu mode
entities.description: Procedure for paging UE to initiate CS fallback to A/Gb or Iu mode when CS services are required.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state where it is registered with the network and can receive paging messages.

entities.name: CS services required
entities.description: Condition triggering CS fallback when circuit-switched services are needed for the UE.

relations.description: CS fallback paging procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
CS fallback paging is triggered when CS services are required for the UE.
